rationale: Builds directly on the current best rank-64 bigram/output-tail path but pivots to a new local-n-gram idea instead of another bigram micro-tweak. This adds a very small rank-12 factorized trigram residual head using the previous two tokens, which should target short-range next-token structure that the final int8 roundtrip metric rewards, while keeping the winning quant-aware training schedule, projection EMA, and export path unchanged. The added tensors stay small enough to remain float-kept under the existing quantizer thresholds, so the hypothesis is extra local modeling capacity with minimal compressed-size risk on the 16 MB cap.
title: Factorized Trigram Tail On Bigram64 Quant Path
